usedFor: SMSFactor texts clients through your SMSFactor account with “Send SMS”, and “Create SMS Template” keeps reusable wording.

bestTemplate.name: “Send SMS” in SMSFactor

watchOut: Texts go out through your SMSFactor account, and anything that reaches a client waits for your approval.
